text.ro: Conducerea este implicata in supravegherea riscurilor cibernetice?
text.en: Is management involved in the oversight of cyber risks?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati implicarea conducerii in supravegherea riscurilor cibernetice si raportare periodica.
recommendation.en: Formalize management involvement in cyber risk oversight and periodic reporting.

text.ro: Exista politici si proceduri de securitate aprobate?
text.en: Are approved security policies and procedures in place?

recommendation.ro: Definiti si aprobati politici si proceduri de securitate aliniate NIS2.
recommendation.en: Define and approve security policies and procedures aligned with NIS2.

nis2: Policies on risk analysis and information system security

text.ro: Sunt rolurile si responsabilitatile de securitate definite?
text.en: Are security roles and responsibilities defined?

recommendation.ro: Clarificati rolurile de securitate, business owner, IT owner si responsabilitati de escalare.
recommendation.en: Clarify security, business owner, IT owner and escalation responsibilities.

text.ro: Personalul de conducere primeste instruire specifica privind cyber security?
text.en: Does management receive dedicated cybersecurity training?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti training periodic pentru management privind obligatiile si riscurile NIS2.
recommendation.en: Introduce periodic training for management on NIS2 obligations and risks.

text.ro: Exista raportare periodica a riscurilor si incidentelor catre management?
text.en: Is there periodic reporting of risks and incidents to management?

recommendation.ro: Instituiti raportare executiva periodica privind riscurile, incidentele si remediation status.
recommendation.en: Establish periodic executive reporting on risks, incidents and remediation status.

text.ro: Exista un proces formal de evaluare si tratare a riscurilor cibernetice?
text.en: Is there a formal process to assess and treat cyber risks?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un proces formal pentru identificare, evaluare, tratare si acceptare a riscurilor.
recommendation.en: Implement a formal process for identifying, assessing, treating and accepting risks.

text.ro: Riscurile sunt prioritizate pe baza impactului asupra serviciilor esentiale?
text.en: Are risks prioritized based on impact to essential services?

recommendation.ro: Prioritizati riscurile pe baza impactului asupra serviciilor si continuitatii operationale.
recommendation.en: Prioritize risks based on impact to services and operational continuity.

text.ro: Exista un registru al riscurilor actualizat periodic?
text.en: Is there a risk register updated periodically?

recommendation.ro: Mentineti un registru al riscurilor cu owner, tratament si termen de revizuire.
recommendation.en: Maintain a risk register with owner, treatment and review date.

text.ro: Exista integrare a riscurilor third-party in evaluarea de risc?
text.en: Are third-party risks integrated into risk assessment?

recommendation.ro: Includeti riscurile furnizorilor si subcontractorilor in modelul de evaluare a riscurilor.
recommendation.en: Include supplier and subcontractor risks in the risk assessment model.

text.ro: Exista evaluare a riscurilor pentru schimbarile majore?
text.en: Is risk assessment performed for major changes?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti evaluare de risc obligatorie pentru schimbari tehnologice si operationale majore.
recommendation.en: Introduce mandatory risk assessment for major technology and operational changes.

text.ro: Exista plan documentat de incident response?
text.en: Is there a documented incident response plan?

recommendation.ro: Definiti si testati un plan de raspuns la incidente cu workflow clar de escalare.
recommendation.en: Define and test an incident response plan with a clear escalation workflow.

text.ro: Exista proces de raportare a incidentelor in ferestrele NIS2?
text.en: Is there a process to report incidents within NIS2 timelines?

recommendation.ro: Definiti proces pentru raportarea initiala, intermediate si finala conform NIS2.
recommendation.en: Define a process for initial, intermediate and final reporting in line with NIS2.

text.ro: Sunt incidentele clasificate dupa severitate si impact?
text.en: Are incidents classified by severity and impact?

recommendation.ro: Instituiti clasificare standard pentru severitate, impact si obligatii de raportare.
recommendation.en: Establish standard classification for severity, impact and reporting obligations.

text.ro: Exista exercitii periodice de incident response?
text.en: Are periodic incident response exercises conducted?

recommendation.ro: Planificati exercitii tabletop si scenarii tehnice pentru incidente majore.
recommendation.en: Plan tabletop exercises and technical scenarios for major incidents.

text.ro: Exista analiza post-incident si imbunatatire continua?
text.en: Is post-incident analysis and continual improvement performed?

recommendation.ro: Implementati post-mortem obligatoriu si actualizati controalele dupa incidente.
recommendation.en: Implement mandatory post-mortems and update controls after incidents.

text.ro: Exista planuri de continuitate si disaster recovery pentru servicii critice?
text.en: Are business continuity and disaster recovery plans in place for critical services?

recommendation.ro: Definiti BCP/DR pentru toate serviciile critice si dependintele acestora.
recommendation.en: Define BCP/DR for all critical services and their dependencies.

text.ro: Planurile de continuitate sunt testate periodic?
text.en: Are continuity plans periodically tested?

recommendation.ro: Testati periodic continuitatea si restaurarea serviciilor critice.
recommendation.en: Periodically test continuity and restoration of critical services.

text.ro: RTO si RPO sunt definite si aprobate?
text.en: Are RTO and RPO defined and approved?

recommendation.ro: Definiti RTO/RPO pentru serviciile critice si obtineti aprobarea managementului.
recommendation.en: Define RTO/RPO for critical services and obtain management approval.

text.ro: Exista redundanta pentru componente esentiale?
text.en: Is redundancy in place for essential components?

recommendation.ro: Implementati redundanta pentru componentele critice si punctele unice de esec.
recommendation.en: Implement redundancy for critical components and single points of failure.

text.ro: Exista plan de comunicare de criza?
text.en: Is there a crisis communication plan?

recommendation.ro: Creati plan de comunicare de criza pentru clienti, management si autoritati.
recommendation.en: Create a crisis communication plan for customers, management and authorities.

text.ro: Exista inventar si clasificare a furnizorilor critici?
text.en: Is there an inventory and classification of critical suppliers?

recommendation.ro: Mentineti inventar si clasificare pentru furnizorii critici si serviciile externalizate.
recommendation.en: Maintain an inventory and classification of critical suppliers and outsourced services.

text.ro: Contractele includ clauze de securitate si notificare incident?
text.en: Do contracts include security and incident notification clauses?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti clauze contractuale pentru cerinte minime de securitate si notificare incident.
recommendation.en: Introduce contractual clauses for minimum security requirements and incident notification.

text.ro: Sunt evaluate periodic riscurile furnizorilor critici?
text.en: Are critical suppliers periodically assessed for risk?

recommendation.ro: Implementati due diligence si reevaluare periodica a furnizorilor critici.
recommendation.en: Implement due diligence and periodic reassessment of critical suppliers.

text.ro: Accesul furnizorilor este limitat si monitorizat?
text.en: Is supplier access limited and monitored?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati least privilege, MFA si monitorizare pentru accesul third-party.
recommendation.en: Apply least privilege, MFA and monitoring for third-party access.

text.ro: Exista evaluare a subcontractorilor / fourth parties?
text.en: Is there assessment of subcontractors / fourth parties?

recommendation.ro: Extindeti procesul TPRM pentru subcontractori si fourth parties relevanti.
recommendation.en: Extend the TPRM process to relevant subcontractors and fourth parties.

text.ro: MFA este implementat pentru acces critic si remote?
text.en: Is MFA implemented for critical and remote access?

recommendation.ro: Activati MFA pentru sisteme critice, VPN, cloud si conturi privilegiate.
recommendation.en: Enable MFA for critical systems, VPN, cloud and privileged accounts.

text.ro: Exista patch management si remediere vulnerabilitati?
text.en: Is patch management and vulnerability remediation in place?

recommendation.ro: Implementati scanare periodica si patch management bazat pe risc.
recommendation.en: Implement periodic scanning and risk-based patch management.

text.ro: Log-urile si monitorizarea de securitate sunt implementate?
text.en: Are logging and security monitoring implemented?

recommendation.ro: Centralizati log-urile si implementati use cases de detectie in SIEM.
recommendation.en: Centralize logs and implement detection use cases in SIEM.

text.ro: Exista control al accesului si segregare pentru retele si sisteme critice?
text.en: Is access control and segregation in place for critical networks and systems?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati segmentare de retea, control de acces si separare administrativa.
recommendation.en: Apply network segmentation, access control and administrative separation.

text.ro: Datele sensibile sunt protejate prin criptare si backup?
text.en: Is sensitive data protected through encryption and backup?

recommendation.ro: Implementati criptare, backup si teste de restaurare pentru date sensibile.
recommendation.en: Implement encryption, backup and restoration testing for sensitive data.
